description: This source file is a firmware cutter tool for extracting parts from an Arcadyan firmware update file, specifically for the W921V model. It decrypts, identifies, and extracts firmware partitions, including LZMA compressed segments.

methods.name: part_type
methods.description: Determines the type of firmware partition based on its ID and returns the corresponding filename for extraction.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that handles user interaction, reads the firmware file, decrypts it, searches for partitions, and extracts LZMA compressed segments.
